title: Record where every asset came from
statement: Record where every asset came from and its hash, check the hash before using it, and treat a source note as a record of origin, not a licence to reuse.
detail:
Each video frame takes its pictures by id and SHA-256, verified before use, and an asset's source note records its
origin, not a right to reuse it (`unit-video-modules/INTEGRATION.md`); the lesson engine checks each painting's bytes
against its manifest before drawing it (`g9/transformer/src/video/art.js`), and every film it makes carries a manifest
of module digests, narrator, renderer versions and file hashes (`g9/transformer/src/video/produce.js`). The kit's
narration rule keeps one folder per model, voice and direction, because a new voice in an old folder leaves old takes
under a new label (`othello-unit-video/.claude/skills/uvk-narration-make/SKILL.md`).
